title: AI-Assisted Decision Support System for Radiologists in the Analysis of Chest X-Rays
content: This paper presents the development of a decision support system for diagnosing pa-thologies in chest X-ray images, based on artificial intelligence methods. The system accelerates primary diagnosis, reducing the workload on radiologists while ensuring high diagnostic accuracy through robustness to image artifacts and suboptimal image quality. The proposed solution includes preprocessing stages (CLAHE, DCP) and foreign object detection (YOLO, evaluated using ROC-AUC, IoU, and mAP metrics). To generate structured reports, the system integrates LLMs with RAG, leveraging clinical guide-lines and report templates. A user-friendly interface allows physicians to review and adjust the results of automated analysis before finalizing the diagnostic report. Keywords: chest radiography, AI-based diagnosis, detection, Clinical Decision Support System (CDSS), human-in-the-loop, AI assistant, computer vision, CNN, YOLO, treatment recommendation, RAG.
